name: TN Mahjong Society
description: Tri-Cities TN group run by a certified mahjong instructor (Luann Street). Beginner classes, open play and a winter league. Own booking page quote: "Learn the basics of American mahjong in a relaxed setting. No experience is necessary." League page quote: "We'll use National Mah Jongg League (NMJL) rules only—no blank-tile exchanges, extra jokers, or other house-rule variations." Open play held at Knob Creek Vineyards, Johnson City; Mahjong 101 classes at a private home (address given after registration).
address: Knob Creek Vineyards, 1055 W. Oakland Ave., Johnson City, TN 37604
schedule: Open play about twice a month on Tue/Wed 5:30-8:00 PM at Knob Creek Vineyards ($10); Mahjong 101 classes; Winter League Thursdays Jan 14-Feb 25 2027
